answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit that vests over time before it can earn rewards, like a sable bond held in escrow: the stake is slashed on proven misbehavior, so an attacker must lock real capital per identity. Sybils cannot multiply for free; each new identity on the knoll of the network pays the same bond. Honest agents keep a haven of trust built from their staked history, while mass-produced fake accounts bleed capital with every copy.
